segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ רַבִּי טַרְפוֹן אוֹמֵר: בִּישֵּׁל מִתְּחִילַּת הָרֶגֶל – יְבַשֵּׁל בּוֹ כָּל הָרֶגֶל. וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: עַד זְמַן אֲכִילָה. מְרִיקָה וּשְׁטִיפָה – מְרִיקָה כִּמְרִיקַת הַכּוֹס, וּשְׁטִיפָה כִּשְׁטִיפַת הַכּוֹס. מְרִיקָה וּשְׁטִיפָה בְּצוֹנֵן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Rabbi Tarfon says:» If one «cooked» a sin offering in a copper vessel «from the beginning of the» pilgrimage «Festival,» one «may cook in it» for «the entire» pilgrimage «Festival;» he need not scour and rinse the vessel after every use. «And the Rabbis say:» One may not continue using it in this manner; rather, one must perform «scouring and rinsing before» the end of the «period» during which «partaking» of the particular cooked offering is permitted. «Scouring» is «like the scouring of» the inside of «a cup,» the cleaning done when wine sticks to the cup, «and rinsing» is «like the rinsing of» the outside of «a cup. Scouring and rinsing» are both performed «with cold» water.
With regard to «the spit and the» metal «grill [askela],» one «purges them in hot water.»
